title: Splitting a real test suite with Depot
summary: Follow our API test suite from one CI job to seven with Depot Test Splitting. Historical timings balance the work, cutting our measured run from 7m39s to 1m37s.
body_markdown: Use` vitest list --filesOnly` to discover test files, then pass that discovery command to` depot/tests-run-action` in a job matrix. Set` candidate-type: classname` to match Vitest's JUnit report. Read the assigned paths from standard input with` xargs` , run those files, and upload each job's JUnit report.
